title: Baum-OS Skill Contract
description: JSON Schema for Baum-OS YAML skill contracts. Validates skill_id, write_mode, approval, paths, evidence, and abort conditions.
$comment: v0.1 — targets the expanded 21-field Baum-OS skill YAML contract used by skills/pi/tier1-docs-draft.skill.yaml. Earlier documentation (docs/pi-compatible-skill-contract-schema-proposal.md, commit 9801521) described a 17-field proposal with different naming (id, approval_tier, network_mode, vault_mode, secret_boundary, evidence_contract, verification, handoff_format). This schema preserves the expanded safety-oriented 21-field set and should be reviewed before runtime validator introduction.

skill_id.description: Unique skill identifier. Dot-separated namespace: e.g. pi.tier1.docs_draft.

purpose.description: What the skill does and does not do.

allowed_agents.description: Agents permitted to execute this skill.

input_contract.description: Required inputs and output format constraints.

context_sources.description: Files the skill may reference as context.

allowed_tools.description: Tool classes permitted. Empty array means --no-tools.

forbidden_tools.description: Tool classes explicitly forbidden. Must be non-empty.

allowed_paths.description: Filesystem paths the skill may read or write.

forbidden_paths.description: Filesystem paths the skill must never access.

write_mode.description: Permitted write behaviour for this skill.

human_approval_required.description: Whether explicit owner approval is required before execution.

secret_policy.description: Controls access to secrets and sensitive files.

prompt_injection_risk.description: Risk level and mitigations for prompt injection.

execution_steps.description: Ordered steps an agent must follow to execute this skill.

verify_steps.description: Checks that must pass after execution.

evidence_required.description: Artifacts that must be created under sandbox/runs/<timestamp>/.

abort_conditions.description: Conditions that must cause immediate abort. Fail-closed.

log_target.description: Path pattern for evidence logs. Must be under sandbox/runs/.

last_reviewed.description: ISO 8601 date of last review. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
